description: Envelope generator — AR when triggered, ASR when gated

params.text: The attack time, 0 to 10 seconds; with a cable at ATT it attenuates that CV instead
The release time, 0 to 10 seconds; with a cable at REL it attenuates that CV instead
The full height of the envelope, 0 to 10V; while a gate is held that height is the sustain level

inputs.text: A trigger runs an attack and a release; a gate holds at the sustain level until it falls. The channels patched here set the polyphony
A 0-10V CV over the attack time, attenuated by the ATTACK knob
A 0-10V CV over the release time, attenuated by the RELEASE knob

outputs.text: The envelope, rising to 10V at the setting of the S knob
A 1ms pulse at 5V when the envelope finishes
